author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two spiked heads at the top left and top right on long handles crossing in an X; reads as crossed maces like the reference. The rejected drawing had rings with heavy stub spikes merging into blobs.
omissions: Each round head with separate spikes is drawn as one six-pointed spiked outline: separate spike lines on a small ring cannot keep 8 units apart at their bases.
drawing_plan: SQUARE symmetric about x 24: star heads centred (13,14) and (35,14), tips r~8, valleys on r5 3-4-5 points, side tips 8 apart; handles 45 degrees from bottom tips (13,22)/(35,22) to (33,42)/(15,42), crossing at (24,33).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'swords' crossed construction; star outline for the spiked head.
